changelog: **External Correction — your buttons now come from the Teensy, not Windows.** When you run External Correction with a PC-side sender, the gate (e.g. "only while the right mouse button is held") is now driven by the mouse on the Teensy itself, reported back over a new wire: **TX3 / pin 14 → FTDI RX**. This fixes a second mouse on the PC accidentally arming the correction — Windows merges all mice into one button state, so only the Teensy can tell which mouse you actually clicked. If you use External Correction, add the TX3 wire (see the updated wiring sheet); if you don't, nothing changes.
